notes: Coverage verified: all 29 source and all 33 target tokens partitioned exactly once across 27 units.

The six written the's count out against three article morphemes (s011, s015, s021) and three supplied ones (on אֲדֹנָי, on the construct עֵץ of עֵץ הַיַּעַר, and on the substantival participle יֹשְׁבֵי), each placed by which word it stands before (rules 29, 46).
Both multi-morpheme fusions satisfy rule 30's one-English-word condition — לָכֵן → Therefore and כַּאֲשֶׁר → As — and each unit's note names the competing head, which is what rule 8 asks for.
As in EZK.15.2, עֵץ־הַגֶּפֶן is attributive (rule 28) while עֵץ הַיַּעַר is arthrous with of and two the's (rule 29); the resumptive object suffix of נְתַתִּיו is unrepresented under rule 22.
